Our Story

Mississippi’s #1 choice for all things wireless

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Poppins|600|||||||” text_font_size=”18px” text_line_height=”1.6em” max_width_last_edited=”off|desktop” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” custom_padding=”||0px||false|false” text_orientation_tablet=”” text_orientation_phone=”center” text_orientation_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Since opening our doors in December 2007, Wireless Wizard LLC has been on a mission to be the #1 trusted choice for everything wireless related in Mississippi. With 20 years of experience in the industry and four convenient locations, we’ve built a reputation for fast, dependable repairs and unbeatable customer service.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_image src=”https://wirelesswizardms.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Untitled-design.png” title_text=”Untitled design” align_tablet=”center” align_phone=”center” align_last_edited=”on|desktop” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ use_background_color_gradient=”on” background_color_gradient_overlays_image=”on” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” custom_padding=”21px|||||” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Poppins|600|||||||” text_font_size=”18px” text_line_height=”1.6em” max_width_last_edited=”off|desktop” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” custom_padding=”||0px||false|false” hover_enabled=”0″ text_orientation_tablet=”” text_orientation_phone=”center” text_orientation_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

What started as a small repair shop with a big dream has grown into a go-to destination for device care across the state. From day one, our goal has been to combine expert technical skills with the kind of personal attention you only get from people who truly care. Over the years, we’ve expanded our services to meet the needs of our community—repairing phones, tablets, laptops, and game systems while also offering a wide range of accessories and quality pre-owned devices. Every step of the way, we’ve stayed true to the belief that our customers deserve honest answers, fair pricing, and repairs they can trust.

Today, Wireless Wizard Cellular Super Store stands as a testament to hard work, dedication, and a passion for helping people stay connected. Our sales team and technicians are still guided by the same values we started with—treating every customer like family, going the extra mile to find solutions, and always doing the job right the first time. Whether you’re walking in with a shattered screen, searching for the perfect upgrade, or simply looking for advice, you can count on us to deliver the same quality, reliability, and care that has defined our story from the very beginning.
